risks.proof: Clear photos of body front, back, top, lens mount, and sensor

risks.risk: True shutter count could exceed claim
risks.proof: Photo of shutter count via Nikon software or third-party counter app
Close-up photos of front/rear lens elements with light shone through

risks.risk: Unexplained ZHIYUN gimbal box not mentioned by seller — unclear if included, empty, or mismatched item

proof_requests: Photos of the actual camera body: front, back, top, lens mount, and sensor
Close-up photos of the lens front and rear elements
Video of camera powering on, shutter firing, and menu/LCD operation
Photo of shutter count readout via software or counter app
Photo of battery and charger with model/brand visible
Clarification on whether the ZHIYUN gimbal is part of this sale, with its own photos
Photo of serial numbers on body and lens matching any documentation
response.reason: The witness confirms this is a Nikon D750 kit in boxed packaging, so it can be priced at worst case, but every seller claim about condition, usage, and included accessories remains unverifiable from photos alone.
